capabilities.name: wc-loan-list-read
capabilities.description: Read the m_wc_loan list as returned by GET /working-capital-loans. The pinned capture holds one seeded loan (id 1, external id SEED-WC-L01, status active), so the read is exercised and its row is transcribed into a parity vector.
capabilities.evidence: Capture loans-list-raw.json under tenant gerege: the running oracle returned {"content":[{... id 1, externalId SEED-WC-L01, status loanStatusType.active ...}],"totalElements":1} for the seeded working-capital loan. The list seam grades id, external_id and status (no money cell), and one parity vector is promoted from it.

capabilities.name: wc-loan-balance-read
capabilities.description: Read one working-capital loan by id (GET /working-capital-loans/{loanId}) and serialise its m_wc_loan_balance row as the response balance block: the thirteen stored columns plus the derived outstanding/due figures. The pinned capture holds one seeded loan (id 1, external id SEED-WC-L01, status active, principal 1000.51, nothing repaid), so the balance read-back after the seeded disbursement is exercised and transcribed into a parity vector.
capabilities.evidence: Capture wc-loan-detail-raw.json under tenant gerege: the running oracle returned the balance block {"id":1,"principal":1000.51,"principalPaid":0.0,"principalAdjustment":0.0,"principalOutstanding":1000.51,"fee":0.0,"feePaid":0.0,"feeOutstanding":0.0,"penalty":0.0,"penaltyPaid":0.0,"penaltyOutstanding":0.0,"realizedIncomeFromDiscountFee":0.0,"unrealizedIncomeFromDiscountFee":0.0,"overpaymentAmount":0.0,"totalExpectedRepayment":1000.51,"totalRepayment":0.0,"totalOutstanding":1000.51,"totalDisbursement":0.0,"totalDiscountFee":0.0,"totalDiscountFeeAdjustment":0.0,"breachPastDueAmount":0.0} on loan externalId SEED-WC-L01. The detail seam grades id, status and nine balance money cells (four stored, five derived), and one parity vector is promoted from it.

seams.name: working-capital-loans-list
seams.description: GET /working-capital-loans on the running Fineract server, tenant gerege: the m_wc_loan list (one seeded loan in the pinned capture).

seams.name: working-capital-loans-detail
seams.description: GET /working-capital-loans/{loanId} on the running Fineract server, tenant gerege: the per-loan balance read-back (one seeded loan in the pinned capture).

note: Working-capital parity-store capability registry. Each capabilities_required name on a vector must map, on the vector's seam, to status exercised, and the capability must be in the graded domain, else the vector is refused (default-deny). Two capabilities are declared: the working-capital loan list read and the per-loan balance read, each exercised and transcribed into a parity vector. The breach-schedule and delinquency-range-schedule seams are NOT declared as exercised because no breach/delinquency range is configured on the seed and no write path has been captured to observe them; declaring them would be a fabricated observation.
